topic: Deployment plan for demographic data updates
summary_markdown:
The conversation revolves around updating and deploying demographic age group data related to a specific task (DOOH-1862). [p1] noted that the designated branch (2025.04.08-religion-demographic) lacked updates, suggesting someone was waiting for changes in the age groups.

[me] confirmed they would start working on it shortly. Later, [me] stated they would finalize the work and deploy it from the release branch. [p1] agreed to this plan and suggested that the current feature branch could be deleted.

Finally, a deployment strategy was established: [p1] will merge the release branch into master tomorrow, while [me] will handle merging their changes into develop, preventing excessive merge conflicts.
decisions: [me] will finalize and deploy the updates from the release branch.
[p1] will merge the release branch into master tomorrow.
